text.p: These are the leading stories in the Moroccan press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Chad's prime minister says his country backs U.N. referendum in Western Sahara.
- Finance Minister Mohamed Kabbaj presents 1997-98 budget to parliament which plans to create 12,620 jobs.
- King Hassan appoints new governors to ensure fairness of elections.
- France considers easing visa procedures for Moroccans.
- Casablanca city council approves the building of a subway after it received financial assurances from French firms.
- Chad says it hopes that Morocco will join again Organisation of African Unity.
